subject: Security intake: SIG + log-sampling window for HeliumCorp
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@heliumcorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@heliumcorp.com
Date: Sun, 8 Jun 2025 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Security intake + SIG questionnaire (request)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro — HeliumCorp is kicking off a vendor intake for observability and logging for any 3rd-party inference platforms. We've started the SIG/CSP questionnaire and would like to schedule a quick intake call to cover the following:

- Which Redwood deployment modes HeliumCorp would use (hosted vs dedicated)
- Log collection windows and options for masked/redacted samples
- Retention and access controls for customer logs (S3 vs in-console)
- Evidence handoff timing for SOC 2 scoping

Would you and a technical teammate be available for a 30–45 minute slot next week? I attached the current SIG spreadsheet to this email and a short log-sample guidelines doc.

Proposed times (ET):
- Tue 10 Jun 10:00–10:45
- Tue 10 Jun 15:00–15:45
- Wed 11 Jun 11:00–11:45

If none of these work, we can open a scheduling poll.

Thanks,
Alyssa Grant
Security Programs Manager
HeliumCorp

Attachments: HeliumCorp_SIG_v1.xlsx (xlsx), log-sample-guidelines.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@heliumcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake + SIG questionnaire (request)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Marissa (security onboarding) and Ben (prod infra) are looped in.

We can take Tue 10 Jun at 15:00 ET — that works best for the team. Calendar invite to follow.

Quick clarifications so we can prep:
1) For log samples, do you need full trace payloads or are redacted/hashed IDs acceptable?
2) Which retention buckets do you want us to demonstrate (30d, 90d, long-term archival)?
3) Any specific compliance artifacts you need in advance of the call (SOC 2 summary, CAIQ snapshot)?

We'll bring:
- Marissa: SIG/CAIQ point-by-point owner
- Ben: logging/ingestion and retention demo

Action items for us prior to the call:
- Prepare a short runbook showing masked sample extraction
- Share a short link to a temporary folder with sample files

Thanks — invite now.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: internal_runbook_draft.md (will not be sent prior to call)

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@heliumcorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake + SIG questionnaire (request)

Thanks — Tue 10 Jun 15:00 ET is perfect. I've accepted the invite.

To your questions:
- Redacted/hashes are fine as long as the original values cannot be reconstructed. We want to be able to validate schema and sampling windows, not the actual PII.
- Please demonstrate 30d and 90d retention tiers; also show how archival exports look for legal holds.
- Please attach a SOC 2 summary and a current CAIQ export to the post-call artifact list; don't need them before the meeting but it helps our audit team if they are uploaded within 48 hours after the call.

I'll upload a small intake checklist to the OneDrive folder and will request our SRE to provide a short list of questions in advance.

Alyssa

Link: https://1drv.ms/u/s!example/helium-intake

Note: Forwarding the SIG spreadsheet to our audit team now.

---
On Sun, Jun 8, 2025 at 1:12 PM Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@heliumcorp.com> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@heliumcorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake + SIG questionnaire (request)

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you earlier (quick note from the call). Summary and action items below.

Meeting notes (10 Jun 2025, 15:00 ET):
- Attendees: Alyssa (HeliumCorp), Karthik (Redwood), Marissa (Redwood), Ben (Redwood), Alyssa's SRE (remote)
- Scope discussed: SIG + CAIQ completion, evidence handoff cadence for SOC 2, and sample log export mechanics.

Decisions / agreements:
- HeliumCorp will accept redacted / hashed logs for sampling validation. Redwood will provide a mapping doc describing the redaction approach.
- Retention demo will cover 30d and 90d hot tiers plus an S3 archival workflow for legal holds.
- Redwood to upload the SOC 2 summary and a CAIQ JSON export to the shared folder within 48 hours post-call.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marissa: Upload CAIQ export and SOC 2 summary to OneDrive (due 2025-06-12) — attachment: CAIQ_export.json, SOC2_summary.pdf
- Ben: Prepare masked log samples (30d + 90d) and a short demo script (due 2025-06-13) — attachments: masked-logs-30d.tar.gz, masked-logs-90d.tar.gz
- Karthik: Provide the redaction mapping doc and notes on access controls (due 2025-06-12) — attachment: redaction-mapping.md
- Alyssa: Share auditor contact and upload HeliumCorp intake checklist to OneDrive (in progress)

Follow-ups:
- Scheduling a deeper walkthrough on key rotation and KMS controls if the auditor requests it (tentative week of 6/23).

Thanks again — we'll post the artifacts to the folder and notify you once ready.

--
Marissa Cole
Security Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: CAIQ_export.json, SOC2_summary.pdf, masked-logs-30d.tar.gz, masked-logs-90d.tar.gz, redaction-mapping.md
